entries.note: Re-tracked 2026-08-16: the 2026-08-13 ruling took `2360:2879` for a /solutions redesign, but that frame is a service landing page under /solutions/ — this frame stays the route's source of record.

entries.name: Software Engineering service page
entries.note: Named "Solutions" in the file but re-ruled by Nick 2026-08-16: a standalone service landing page under /solutions/, not the index — Interior Hero, Service Grid, statement band, Use cases. #93 built the layer at this route; `1925:6138` stays the /solutions frame.

entries.name: Insight index
entries.note: The frame #61 commissioned — Interior Hero, filter bar, card grid. Ruled canonical 2026-08-13; #61 clears the provisional marker against it.

entries.name: Sanity partnership
entries.note: A platform-partnership landing page, ruled canonical 2026-08-13. #92 settled the route as /partners/sanity — a multi-segment page slug under a new pageType 'partner', with Vercel and Lovable behind it; the Home platforms rail already names all three. No 402 frame, the same gap About and Solutions have.

entries.name: Button / Solid
entries.note: Superseded by the 2026-08 `Button` set (`2134:1785`), which `Button` is now built to (#150). Still tracked so an edit to it reads as a change to a dead set rather than as an unexplained frame diff.

entries.name: Button / Ghost
entries.note: The `variant="ghost"` case; still needs Figma's fill and label treatment.

entries.name: Button (2026-08 rebuild)
entries.note: The redesign's button — Theme = Black | White | Red, radius 5, 12x16 padding, 12px gap — which every redesigned frame instances. `Button` carries its geometry (#150) and `FilterChip` (packages/ui/src/components/filter-chip.tsx) is drawn from it too, so a change here routes to both. The set has no size axis; `Button`'s base | large is authored.

entries.name: Icon (2026-08 set)
entries.note: Twenty-nine glyphs in a 20x20 frame, one variant axis (`Icon`) — Lucide-traced strokes, plus four filled social brand marks (`2177:1603`, `2177:1605`, `2177:1607`, `2177:1609`) that route nowhere. Three of the strokes are the curated set a button's `icon` knob picks from (#151) — arrow-right (2177:1559), external-link (2177:1585), chevron-down (2177:1567) — vendored as inline SVG rather than installed (ADR 0009). A change to one of those three routes to `button-icons.tsx`; a change to the other twenty-six routes nowhere yet.

entries.name: Brand / Logo
entries.note: `Color` is the one axis. `White` is unbuilt on purpose — no canonical frame instances it, and the 2026-08 Footer's white logo is the plate-less `BrandMark`, not this variant (#87).

entries.name: Icon / Surface
entries.note: The insights prev/next. Live's instances are links, not controls, so `InFlightSection` inlines the circle instead (#50).

entries.name: Icon / Soft
entries.note: Not standalone — a part: the inner chip of `Icon / Surface`.

entries.name: .building block Icon_text
entries.note: No component — ADR 0009. Material Symbols glyphs are inline SVG (`ArrowIcon`, `CloseIcon`), never a string prop.

entries.name: NavBar
entries.note: A two-variant set — `Property 1` = Dark (`2225:2920`, the node canonical frames instance) | Light (`3271:17012`). Both draw the pill at `40px 12px 12px 40px` and differ only in fill: Dark `rgba(3,3,3,0.6)`, Light `rgba(255,255,255,0.8)` — the bar's two skins, which `--color-scrim-pill` and `--color-scrim-light` carry. Source of record for the nav's display labels (Work · Live · Insights · Solutions · About + "Let's talk"), for the pill's radius, and for both scrims. Tracked at the SET from 2026-09-03: the manifest had `2225:2920`, which the Light variant's arrival demoted from set to child — the read-a-child-not-the-parent trap `docs/agents/figma.md` names.

entries.name: Utility Nav
entries.note: New 2026-08 brand-property bar above the NavBar (O3 World · 1682 Conference · O3XO), instanced by canonical frames. Built in #88: in flow at the top of the document (the frame marks it `SCROLLS` where the NavBar is `FIXED`), desktop only, links from `siteSettings.utilityNavItems`.

entries.name: Footer
entries.note: Became canonical 2026-08: the Home frame's footer (`2435:1840`) is now an override-free instance of this component — the old frame footer `1680:2096` is gone, superseding #41's from-the-frame decision. `SiteFooter` was realigned to it in #87 — black band, 64px 96px, the plate-less white mark (`1280:1856`), "Go birds." on hover. One open delta: the legal row is `#AAA69E` against `--color-fg-subtle`; the ring matches (`SiteFooter` draws the filled `#0A0A0B` donut, `1320:117`).

entries.name: Case study cards
entries.note: Generation-1, one of three competing sets. Canonical Home draws its cards as frames (`1683:2661`), not instances.

entries.name: Case study cards
entries.note: The one non-canonical set a canonical frame instances — Solutions' three engagement cards (`1925:6113`–`6115`, #47). Nothing case-study about the content, so `PanelCards` composes it locally and the set stays non-canonical.

entries.name: Icon / Solid
entries.note: Superseded by `Icon / Surface`.

entries.name: Badge
entries.note: No canonical use.

entries.name: Pro-series
entries.note: AB WIP canvas.

entries.name: Go birds.
entries.note: Easter egg, instanced beside the Footer's copyright line. Not a component in code: the string is Site Settings' `copyrightNote` and the set's `State=Hover` is a `hover:` utility on it (#87). The set's eagle vector draws nothing in that instance and is not exported.

entries.name: CTA
entries.note: The closing band: Device = Desktop (`2124:72`) | Mobile (`2177:1353`), 1440/402, black, one decoration — the molecule at 775.9 square, 15%, centred, over a "Get in touch" button. The software-engineering (`2354:2640`) and Sanity partner (`2478:2134`) frames instance it override-free; the rest close on a copy of Home's bespoke `1680:2132` instead, whose raster is a video capture of that band's own sphere (#303) rather than anything this set draws. Tracked from 2026-08-16: #163 found the band a generation behind and nothing reported the drift, because the set the band is built to was not watched.

entries.name: Interior Hero
entries.note: The ink hero on every interior and collection frame: Device = Desktop (`2101:828`) | Mobile (`2107:1042`), #0A0A0B, eyebrow + h2 + standfirst. `CollectionHero`'s `interior` variant is built to it. Tracked from 2026-08-16 alongside `CTA` and `Blog` — the three page-level sets the component map had never carried.

entries.name: Blog
entries.note: The insight band on Home and the insight index: Property 1 = Default (`2134:1302`, 1440×866) | Mobile (`2204:1145`, 402×1372), bone, 48px gap. Its axis is the unnamed `Property 1` where the other two page sets use `Device`; the values still read Desktop/Mobile, so it is one axis, not a second vocabulary. `CarouselTrack` already reads the mobile variant. Tracked from 2026-08-16.

entries.name: Services
entries.note: One column of the sideways track — index, 64/76 heading, 24/34 body, a quieter "Best when…" line and a text link — instanced three times by Home's "How we work" (`2846:5480`, #309) and three times again by About's "What we optimize for." (`2960:7022`, #305). A component, not a set: no variant axis, so a change to it is a change to every column on both bands. The link the component draws is its own default on all six instances and neither band builds it. Tracked from 2026-08-24.

entries.name: Case Study Card
entries.note: The case-study card as a set at last: 1246 × 550 filling a 1248 column, radius 32, padding 64 uniform, space-between over a gap floor of 66 — a 180 × 80 logo holder above a 1118 content row that is 559 of text beside 559 of deadspace, holding an eyebrow (18/24 bold, red #C90E00), a 24/34 narrative, a stat row and a white `Button / Solid`. The /work index instances it three times (`2107:1094`–`1096`) and the case-study detail's next-project band once (`2250:1564`); at 402 the stack `2975:8428` overrides the padding to 24 side / 64 top-and-bottom. Its axis — the `Variant` property, Caron | Ironman | Vertex — is which client the demo shows, so it maps to no `cva` key. The gen-1 sets `264:573` / `1393:3025` never became canonical; this one did. Tracked from 2026-08-24 (#302), internals read from the node tree at file version 2391349966960467923 (#314); the renderer draws all of it since #319.

entries.name: Quote
entries.note: The pull quote as a band-level set — Device = Device3 | Mobile, where `Device3` is the desktop value under a default name. Bone #F1F0EC, 96 of side padding at 1440 (`2748:4829`) and 16 at 402 (`2748:4686`), a centred 1034 column at 192 of vertical padding (128 at 402), 48 between the quote and the attribution (24 at 402); the quote is 64/76 Light at -1px of tracking in #232323 (36/44 at 402), the attribution 18/24 bold uppercase at 0.1em in fg-muted #76746F (16/20 at 402). Home instances it twice — `2748:4767` at 1440 × 1012 and `2748:4804` at 402 × 804 — both hanging the 776px molecule off the bottom-left corner at 10%. The case-study detail's loose `Section - Quote` (`2250:1525`) is the same block drawn a generation earlier and still disagrees with the set on alignment, type step and a gradient fill; that is #323's open question. Tracked from 2026-08-24 (#323).
